info.title: Smartify Partner Catalog API
info.description: Brand-scoped catalog approval, approved partner stock sync, and quantity-based availability. Sync requires an approved catalog product and approved managed inventory offer; does not approve products or offers.

post.description: Submit an eligible product for human review. A 202 response does not publish a listing. Resubmission creates a new revision; client retries create another revision in this release. Brand/make is mandatory and must match an active Smartify-approved organization brand grant.

post.description: Requires smartify_admins. Smartify verifies ownership or authorized-supplier evidence for each brand. Brand names selected by a partner in their profile do not grant access. Enabling access requires at least one verified grant. Removing a grant prevents future submissions and approvals for that brand. Server stamps reviewer and time.

422.description: Invalid/duplicate brand grant or missing authorization evidence

post.description: Absolute per-item sync, preserving reservations. Only approved partner products, approved managed offers, active seller membership, and verified brand rights qualify. Completed batches may contain failures. Replays return recorded outcomes, including failures; use a new request ID and current version for a corrective retry. Omissions never zero stock. Managed offer approval must match the current brand and exact approved catalog submission revision. A replacement requires renewed offer review after existing reservations are resolved.

post.description: Read-only check of exact canonical approved partner catalog SKUs. API-key calls are scoped to the key organization; Cognito reads may check approved sellers. A quantity is unknown when verification is missing, older than 24 hours, or inconsistent. Does not reserve stock, aggregate other sellers, promise delivery, or place orders. Managed offer approval must match the current brand and exact approved catalog submission revision. A replacement requires renewed offer review after existing reservations are resolved.

PartnerBearer.description: Authenticated active partner; owner/admin role required for stock mutation. Organization is server-derived.

openStandards.description: Devices require at least one approved open standard. Accessories may use an empty array. Transport or cloud-app compatibility alone does not qualify.

automationUse.description: Required, nonblank automation-use justification for accessories.

partner_sku.description: Normalized to uppercase; whitespace becomes hyphens. Other allowed characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.

revision.description: New submissions start at 1; legacy records lacking this field are reviewed as revision 0.

partner_sku.description: Normalized to uppercase; whitespace becomes hyphens. Other allowed characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.

brand.description: Brand bound to the organization grant at submission.

evidence_reviewed.description: Admin confirms the evidence and eligibility declarations were verified, or the deletion request was verified.

partner_sku.description: Normalized to uppercase; whitespace becomes hyphens. Other allowed characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.

catalog_brand_grants.description: Complete replacement for the approved brand scope. Required when enabling access without existing grants. Empty array revokes all brand grants and requires access disabled.

partnerSku.description: Your own partner SKU, normalized to uppercase

onHandUnits.description: Absolute units allocated to this Smartify offer, including its Smartify reservations, excluding quantities committed to other channels. Never a delta or global warehouse total.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: Actual allocated-stock observation time with timezone, not upload time; must be newer than both the previous snapshot and the last Smartify dispatch, and not in the future.

expectedVersion.description: Current approved offer version from availability or the previous sync result

sku.description: Exact canonical approved partner catalog SKU, not a partner-local SKU
